description: Agent wrote directly to Obsidian vault file using Write tool instead of using Obsidian MCP server. This bypasses vault integrity checks, conflict resolution, and proper sync mechanisms.
violation: Obsidian vault files must ONLY be written through the Obsidian MCP server. Direct filesystem writes bypass vault locking, conflict detection, and sync protocols.
root_cause: Agent used Write tool for vault output instead of routing through Obsidian MCP.
impact: Potential vault corruption, sync conflicts, file corruption if Obsidian was accessing the file simultaneously.
remediation_taken: Agent instructed on correct Obsidian access pattern
correct_pattern: Use mcp__obsidian-local__create_vault_file or mcp__obsidian-local__update_active_file for all vault writes
